Simulation results: equalblocks.01

Published

October 29, 2026

Scenario

High dimensional scenario intended for p = 1000 (npredictors is NOT a signature key; it is passed on the run_sim.sh command line). Three blocks of equal size (indep / weak / strong), 30 designed actives spread evenly across them (10 per block). |beta1| ~ Uniform(0.25, 0.75) with a random sign, so each active effect is in [0.25, 0.75] or [-0.75, -0.25]. Magnitudes were softened from an earlier draft (50 actives, U(0.5, 1.5)) whose linear predictor had sd ~5.9, which made event type nearly deterministic for half the sample. beta2 = -beta1 via the “neg_beta1” sentinel.

Run health

Code 
health <- run_health(res, models)
kbl(health)
Code 
bad <- health[health$Usable < health$Runs, ]
if (nrow(bad)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## Failed fits\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- **%s**: %d of %d runs usable.%s\n", bad$Model, bad$Usable,
              bad$Runs, ifelse(bad$Usable == 0,
                               " It is absent from every plot and table below.",
                               "")), sep = "")
  cat(":::\n")
}
